carousels.title: Feeling safe to feel
carousels.first_line: Somewhere along the way, you learned to feel from the neck up.

carousels.title: Sensuality is not sexuality
carousels.first_line: Sensuality is not sexuality. We were taught to confuse the two.

carousels.title: Inhabiting your body
carousels.first_line: Imagine standing outside your own home, and finally walking back in.

carousels.title: The beauty myth
carousels.first_line: You were never sold a product. You were sold the feeling that you are not enough.

carousels.title: The performative feminine
carousels.first_line: You learned to abandon yourself before anyone else had the chance to reject you.

posts.quote: Sensuality is how we make sense of reality.
Feeling is the thing that plugs us back into life.
A sensual woman is difficult to control, because she is at home in herself.
You are allowed to slow down. Slowness is where you meet yourself.
Reclaiming sensuality is not about becoming more desirable. It is about becoming intimate with life.
Make life your lover. The morning tea. The warm water. The sunlight on your skin.
You are not here to become a different woman. You are remembering the one who came before the world told you who to be.
